components.text:
These rites come with Supernatural Bloodlines and work like all circle magic: draw the golden heart glyph and the circle, put the items in it and activate it.

The basics: $(b)$(el:circle_magic/tutorial/performing_rites)Performing Rites$(/el)$(/b).

Many of these rites act on whoever stands on the heart glyph in the centre. When nobody does, they act on whoever performs the rite.

A rite a server has switched off shows a note in place of its circle.
